title: High Priest Valon and the Plasmatic followers
summary: Jimmic Adle reveals High Priest Valon with five Plasmatic followers.
overview: Jimmic Adle reveals High Priest Valon with five Plasmatic followers.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Prepare to control several enemies immediately after the trigger.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: A cleric at the required pre-epic step starts the event through Jimmic's turn-in; the next step also supports a hail trigger.
Valon appears with two priests and three priestesses around the same location.
Jimmic depops after creating the encounter.

notes: Approval E284. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
